title: Highly suggested!
text: This tour was super interesting!  We loved going through the Casa Batllo!  Lots of history and stories.  We really enjoyed it and would definitely suggest this to everyone!
author: Linda_B

title: Banister Fletcher influences my travel…
text: The tour guide was exceptionally knowledgeable.  I wish that I had more time to explore other buildings.  Maybe the next time.
author: Wikita_S

title: Architectural wizard
text: We spent a great morning with Gloria. She has a wealth of knowledge, and is a lovely person. The outside of the building is amazing (we’ve seen it before), but the interior completes the perspective as seen through Dali’s eyes. Gloria also taught us about the Batillo family, and their relationship with Dali. The tour was definitely worth the time and money, and not standing in line was the cherry on the sundae.
author: Lou_S

title: Casa Batllo Tour
text: Gemma, arrive on time and got started right away. She was very knowledgable and made the tour interesting. She was able to maneuver the house, crowd and kept the tour moving along..
author: Lynne_J

title: Early morning and skip the line was great.
text: My son and I did this tour first thing in the morning and the easy entrance and thorough tour with our guide was just what we were hoping for.  Skipping the line was great and a guide accompanying us with steady information was perfect.  We were a group of 5 so it was easy to follow along and ask questions as needed.
author: Katherine_M

title: Excellent Guide and Tour.
text:
Miguel Perez was our guide. He was immediately welcoming and enthusiastic when we met him on the street. He made the tour thoroughly enjoyable. He is quite knowledgeable about the Casa Batllo and thoroughly satisfied our curiosity and questions about the wonderful building. 

I highly recommend Miguel and this tour.  If one tries to simply walk through the building, you would get no appreciation of the finer points. He truly made the visit a memorable experience.

The  Casa Batllo is truly unique and adds greatly to understanding the full breath of Gaudi's work.
author: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaz

title: Miguel is a great guide
text: Miguel (our guide) was very knowable and also very accommodating. A lovely human being. Definitely a better experience than if we’d gone on our own.
author: Elizabeth_N

title: Great Tour and Awesome Guide
text: Miguel was impressive and informative.  The experience was awesome.  Attention to detail and engagement was a real differentiator.  One of the highlights of our trip to Boit Barcelona.
author: Victorcosmopolis

title: Great experience
text: The staff helped us with our tickets, they were very patient and helpful. We had a great experience, thank you!
author: ellenh804

title: The guide is very knowledgeable!
text: Beauty of the genius mind and his love for the nature. Tour was in time, everything was right. We were not waiting in line,
